text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today as well, at her own whimsical pace, 
Gold Ship went all out tearing across 
ParisLongchamp Racecourse in the VR 
Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like her usual incomprehensible 
behavior, yet it also carried a hint of 
fierce resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she challenged <chrname> to one final showdown 
at the Representative Exhibition Match.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship flashes a smile at the phrase 
"the end," as if it were all just a joke. 
Yet somehow, you feel like she isn't 
bluffing at all.
